Prebuilt 32-bit MinGW archives the sh1x match server links (scripts/build-server.sh copies them into server/sh1x/lib):
mbedtls (libmbedcrypto.a, libmbedtls.a, libmbedx509.a; Apache-2.0) and libtomcrypt (libtomcrypt.a; public domain /
Unlicense), as built by the CoD4x server's own lib build scripts. Set K33_SERVER_LIBS to use another folder.
